"Moon pe target. Miss bhi karo, stars ke beech landing."
"Bahut fail ka dare, tabhi badi achievement."
Tumhara mind bohot powerful hai.
Mind ko muscle jaisa train karna padta.
Janna hi kaafi nahi hai, prayog bhi karna hoga. Chhahna hi kaafi nahi hai, karna bhi hoga.
Hum wohi hain jo sochte hain.
Mind enlightened ho jaye—phir unenlightened nahi hota.
Tumhara samay seemit hai, kisi aur ki zindagi jeene mein barbaad mat karo.
Jo andar hai, uske saamne kuch nahi.
Quality ek act nahi, habit hai.
